title: Apollo telemetry data and original footage destroyed

tellings.quote: Also, the all the telemetry data was destroyed, which is crazy.

plain: The telemetry from the Apollo missions, the NASA flights that landed men on the moon starting in 1969, is said to have been destroyed, along with original footage. Telemetry is the data radioed back from a spacecraft. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan says it on the show: "all the telemetry data was destroyed, which is crazy," and he tells it as something that raises questions about what records of the missions survive.
